doc: A mixin: `…ForMaskedLM` over a BERT-lineage encoder (mixin-bert-encoder): EVERY row of the encoder through the head's transform (`HEAD_TRANSFORM_V1`: dense, the model's activation, LayerNorm) and the vocabulary projection, which is tied to the word embeddings (`tie_word_embeddings`, true for every transformers MLM head) and carries the head's own bias — `[L, vocab]` logits per token (`OutputSpec::MaskedLm`). The program reads no mask position: the row at the masked position is what a user reads. The decoder weight of an older checkpoint (`…decoder.weight`) is the embedding table and is not read twice. HFX 2026-10-10.
